messages.text: The survey team plans to leave after the second bell.
No one has said whether that means the noon bell or evening bell.
Yori will post the confirmed departure time.
The survey team is waiting at Reed Camp.

main_story.headline: Logistical Clarification for the Survey Team
main_story.lede: Local communications focused on determining the specific departure timing and current location of the survey team.
main_story.body:
Discussions regarding the movement of the survey team centered on their pending transition from *Reed Camp*. **Wren** stated that the group plans to leave following the *second bell*.

This statement prompted a query from **Xara** concerning whether the instruction refers to the noon or evening period. To resolve this ambiguity, it was established that **Yori** will provide the confirmed departure time in an upcoming update.
